column1: # Tabell: Pensions at a Glance: kompensasjonsgrad, pensjonsalder, inntekt og fattigdom blant eldre, levealder
# REF_AREA: DEU=Germany; DNK=Denmark; FIN=Finland; GBR=United Kingdom; ISL=Iceland; NLD=Netherlands; NOR=Norway; SWE=Sweden; USA=United States

# MEASURE: ATRAEP=Average tax rate of average earner pensioners; ATRPPAE=Average tax rate of pensioners with pension equal to average earnings; ATRW=Average tax rate of workers; AWGW=Average worker gross wage; CIOP=Capital income of older people; CRPLF22=Current retirement age for a person who entered the labour force at age 22; EDIOP=Equivalised disposable income of older people; EIOP=Employment income of older people; ELMEA=Effective labour market exit age; ER=Employment rate; EYLME=Expected years after labour market exit; FR=Fertility rate; FRPLF22=Future retirement age for a person who entered the labour force at age 22; GPRR100=Gross pension replacement rate at 100% of average wage; GPRR200=Gross pension replacement rate at 200% of average wage; GPRR50=Gross pension replacement rate at 50% of average wage; GPW100=Gross pension wealth at 100% of average wage; GPW200=Gross pension wealth at 200% of average wage; GPW50=Gross pension wealth at 50% of average wage; LE=Life expectancy; NPRR100=Net pension replacement rate at 100% of average wage; NPRR200=Net pension replacement rate at 200% of average wage; NPRR50=Net pension replacement rate at 50% of average wage; NPW100=Net pension wealth at 100% of average wage; NPW200=Net pension wealth at 200% of average wage; NPW50=Net pension wealth at 50% of average wage; OAIP=Old age income poverty rate below 50% of median income; OAWAR=Old-age to working-age ratio; OCOP=Occupational transfers to older people; PEP=Public expenditure on pensions; PPEP=Projections of public expenditure on pensions; PTOP=Public transfers to older people

# UNIT_MEASURE: CH_W=Children per woman; FCTR_WG_SAL_G_I_INC=Factor of gross individual wage at the same income level; FCTR_WG_SAL_N_I_INC=Factor of net individual wage at the same income level; PT_B1GQ=Percentage of GDP; PT_B6G_A_POP_Y_GT65=Percentage of gross disposable income of the population aged over 65 years; PT_B6N_A=Percentage of average disposable income; PT_EARN_A=Percentage of average earnings; PT_EARN_G_PRE_RET_INC=Percentage of gross pre-retirement earnings at the same income level; PT_EARN_N_PRE_RET_INC=Percentage of net pre-retirement earnings at the same income level; PT_PENS=Percentage of pension; PT_POP_AGE=Percentage of population in the same age; PT_POP_SEX_AGE=Percentage of population in the same sex and age; PT_POP_Y20T64=Percentage of population aged 20-64 years; USD_EXC=US dollars, exchange rate converted; XDC=National currency; Y=Years

# AGE: BIRTH=At birth; Y55T59=From 55 to 59 years; Y60T64=From 60 to 64 years; Y65=65 years; Y65T69=From 65 to 69 years; Y66T75=From 66 to 75 years; Y_GE65=65 years or over; Y_GE66=66 years or over; Y_GE76=76 years or over; _T=Total; _Z=Not applicable
# OPTIONALITY: M=Mandatory; MV=Mandatory and voluntary; _Z=Not applicable
